title: Toggle Fortune
description: This projects adds a keybind, V, which allows the user to toggle between fortune and silk touch on their desired tool
body:
✨ Features

Dual Enchanting
Combine Silk Touch and Fortune on the same tool using an anvil.

Instant Toggle
Press V to switch between Silk Touch and Fortune at any time.

Smart Loot Handling
Only the active enchantment is applied when breaking blocks, ensuring drops behave exactly as they should.

Clear Tooltip Display
Hover over your tool to see which enchantment mode is currently active.

🔧 How to Use

Combine Silk Touch and Fortune on a tool using an anvil

Hold the enchanted tool in your main hand

Press V to toggle between modes

Check the tooltip to confirm the active enchantment

📋 Requirements

Minecraft 1.21.1

Fabric Loader 0.18.2+

Fabric API 0.139.5+1.21.11

⚙️ Compatibility Notes

Server-side installation is required for correct loot behavior

Both client and server must have the mod installed
